definitions.explanation: The measure of rotation between two lines meeting at a point, measured in degrees.
A particular way of looking at or thinking about something.

examples.japanese: この{三角形|さんかっけい}の{角度|かくど}を{測|はか}ってください。
examples.english: Please measure the angles of this triangle.

examples.japanese: カメラの{角度|かくど}を{変|か}えてみよう。
examples.english: Let's try changing the camera angle.

examples.japanese: {別|べつ}の{角度|かくど}から{問題|もんだい}を{考|かんが}える{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to think about the problem from a different perspective.

notes:
MATHEMATICAL TERMS:
・{直角|ちょっかく} (right angle - 90°)
・{鋭角|えいかく} (acute angle - less than 90°)
・{鈍角|どんかく} (obtuse angle - more than 90°)
・{角度|かくど}を{測|はか}る (to measure an angle)

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
・{角度|かくど}を{変|か}える (to change one's approach/perspective)
・{別|べつ}の{角度|かくど}から (from a different angle/perspective)
・{様々|さまざま}な{角度|かくど}から (from various perspectives)
・この{角度|かくど}から{見|み}ると (from this perspective)

RELATED WORDS:
・{視点|してん} (viewpoint - more abstract)
・{観点|かんてん} (standpoint - formal)
・アングル (angle - photography/film term)
